🏍️ Gear up and get ready for Motorcycle Mayhem, the ultimate traffic-swerving adventure in Roblox! Take control of powerful motorcycles, dodge through relentless traffic, and fight to stay alive. Unlock new bikes, and challenge your friends to epic races. Just don't hesitate...

⭐ Claim your role and join Breakneck Interactive for in-game rewards! 🎁

Controls:

WASD to drive
M to switch to manual/automatic
CTRL to wheelie
SHIFT for pbrake
V for camera mode
E and Q to switch gears in manual
H for siren (on police bikes)
Shift and P for freecam
